parsed.change_summary: Added a reallocation of the buffer if the initial size is insufficient to hold the executable path.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now checks if the initial buffer is too small and reallocates it with the required size before attempting to print the executable path again.
parsed.behavior_changes: The behavior has changed in that the program now attempts to reallocate the buffer if the initial size is insufficient and tries to get the executable path again. If the reallocation fails, it prints an error message.
